fitting: Frozen content vectors; every fit positive with eight own-impression logged nonclicks (replacement if fewer). Impressions lacking nonclicks are counted and excluded only from fitting softmax, never evaluation.
session_context: Per-user timestamp groups; mean of previous displayed-and-clicked item vectors. Available only strictly after five minutes; inactivity gap greater than30min resets. Current and equal-time labels never affect current features. No within-impression click order is inferred.
feedback_assumption: MIND does not supply click timestamps. Five-minute delivery is a fixed simulation assumption. Earlier development outcomes may update later session features only; all weights are frozen. Long-only trained ablation uses no replayed feedback.
training: Two separate identically seeded architectures, long-only zero session feature versus session GRU, fixed final epoch. No tuning/stopping on development outcomes.
ranking_controls: Relevance rank scale. Fresh weight.15 and24h first-observation-age half-life. Balanced fresh.10/diversity.15, half max cosine redundancy and half category share. Top10 then remaining relevance order.
evaluation: All chronological training-archive development impressions. Four logged arms: long-only, session, session+fresh, session+balanced. Three session catalog policies use union of frozen learned100 and popularity100, no oracle injection. All logged positives remain in catalog denominators, including unavailable/unretrieved ones.
exposure_bias: Training negatives restricted to logged nonclicks. Per-training-exposure positive recall bins0/1-99/100-999/1000+, article-macro recall10, cold/empty/session/daily segments. Descriptive sensitivity only; absent propensities/randomization, no unbiased IPS, causal lift or full-catalog AUC claim.
verification: Independent raw-TSV audit of all contexts and all scores/segments. Feature tolerance1e-6; ranking metric1e-10, age1e-8, cosine diversity1e-7.128ID-selected policy queries with independent brute-force utility tolerance1e-6.256saved-model reload impressions per arm. Every catalog pool strictly earlier and exact source union.
official_validation_archive: Remain sealed until final model/protocol freeze.
documentation_clarification: See protocol-documentation-clarification.json. The original 24h half-life wording is corrected to 24h decay scale; frozen formula/behavior unchanged.
